<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Tigray conflict]]
**[[Ethiopian National Defense Force]] troops open fire on [[United Nations]] staffers who were trying to reach areas where "they were not supposed to go" near [[Sheraro]] in the [[Tigray Region]], according to senior [[Government of Ethiopia|Ethiopian government]] official [[Redwan Hussein]]. There are no reported casualties. UN spokesman [[Stephane Dujarric]] says the reports are "alarming". [https://apnews.com/article/africa-ethiopia-united-nations-kenya-f945a81239325a418ee22f123058f39f (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Pope Francis]] issues the apostolic letter Patris Corde (“With a Father’s Heart”) for the 150th anniversary of the declaration of [[Saint Joseph]] as patron of the universal Church. The Pope declares a special Year of St. Joseph (December 8, 2020 — December 8, 2021). [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2020-12/apostolic-penitentiary-plenary-indulgence-year-st-joseph.html (Vatican News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A helicopter crash in the [[French Alps]], leaves five people dead and another injured. The helicopter was carrying an air rescue crew on a training mission. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-helicopter/helicopter-crashes-in-french-alps-six-people-missing-idUSKBN28I33X?il=0 (Reuters)]
*In [[Belle, West Virginia]], [[United States]], an explosion at the [[Chemours]] [[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]] prompts a now-cancelled [[shelter-in-place]] to be issued for Belle and in surrounding areas; the explosion leaves one person dead, and three others injured. Along with the shelter-in-place, schools in [[Kanawha County, West Virginia|Kanawha County]], the county Belle resides in, were closed for Wednesday. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/12/09/explosion-wv-chemical-plant-injures-4-prompts-stay-inside-order/6504815002/ (''USA Today'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****[[Morocco]] says that its [[Sinopharm]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] will be free for all citizens and will be rolled out in the following weeks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/healthcoronavirus-morocco/morocco-says-covid-19-vaccine-will-be-free-to-all-citizens-idUSL1N2IO22Z (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports 26,567 new cases, the lowest in the country since July 10. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-india-cases/india-reports-lowest-daily-rise-in-coronavirus-cases-since-july-10-idUSFWN2IN166 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports 47 new deaths in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/08/national/tokyo-confirms-352-new-covid-19-infections/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a new single-day record of 211 new deaths, bringing the nationwide death toll to 15,304. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-reports-more-than-33000-daily-coronavirus-cases/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The U.S. surpasses 15 million cases of COVID-19, with about one out of every 22 Americans having tested positive since the pandemic began. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2020/12/08/covid-news-britain-vaccine-wyoming-california-donald-trump/6481339002/ (''USA Today'')]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****[[Americans|American]] regulators from the [[Food and Drug Administration]] confirm that [[Pfizer]]'s [[vaccine]] candidate is 95% effective. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/graphics/2020/health/pfizer-vaccine-trial-results/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] hosts an [[Operation Warp Speed]] vaccine summit. [[Governor of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]], [[Governor of Texas|Texas Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]], [[Governor of Tennessee|Tennessee Governor]] [[Bill Lee (Tennessee politician)|Bill Lee]], and [[Governor of Louisiana|Louisiana Governor]] [[John Bel Edwards]] attend the event. [https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-to-host-vaccine-summit-with-governors-fdas-peter-marks-2020-12 (''Business Insider'')]
*****President Trump says that he will invoke the [[Defense Production Act of 1950]] to provide vaccine doses if necessary. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-08/trump-vows-to-use-defense-production-act-if-needed-for-vaccines (Bloomberg.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] says that he will issue an executive order that would require [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|face masks]] in federal buildings on the first day of [[Presidency of Joe Biden|his presidency]]. The order will last for the first 100 days that he holds office. [https://www.newsweek.com/biden-impose-mask-mandate-day-one-presidency-executive-order-1553285 (''Newsweek'')]
*****[[Jenna Ellis]], lawyer to President Trump, tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. This comes just two days after [[Rudy Giuliani]], another of Trump's lawyers, also tested positive. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/08/world/jenna-ellis-trump-covid.html (''The New York Times'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] surpasses 10,000 confirmed deaths from COVID-19. In response, [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] orders flags to fly at half staff for the next 10 days. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/2020/12/08/michigan-coronavirus-cases-up-to-410295-death-toll-now-at-10138/ (WDIV-TV)] [https://nbc25news.com/news/coronavirus/gov-whitmer-lowers-flags-to-honor-10000-michigan-lives-lost-to-covid-19 (WEYI-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]]
*****[[Governor of Massachusetts|Massachusetts Governor]] [[Charlie Baker]] announces that the [[Massachusetts|state]] will tighten restrictions and move back to phase 3 of the reopening plan. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/529283-massachusetts-tightening-coronavirus-restrictions-amid-rise-in-cases (''The Hill'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]]
*****[[Governor of Colorado|Colorado Governor]] [[Jared Polis]] announces that the [[Colorado|state]] will extend its statewide mask mandate for 30 more days amid a rise of cases in the state. [https://kdvr.com/news/local/gov-polis-extends-mask-mandate-for-another-30-days-upward-trend-continues/ (KDVR)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Manitoba]]
*****[[Manitoba]] extends its COVID-19 restrictions into January. However, drive-in church services will be exempted, thrift stores will be allowed to reopen, and sales of [[Christmas]] and holiday items will be permitted. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/manitoba-covid19-public-health-order-update-1.5832699 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] imposes tough new restrictions in a bid to curb soaring COVID-19 infections including the closure of all casinos and gyms, banning dine-in service at restaurants and bars, imposing a mandatory provincewide mask requirement, banning all outdoor and indoor social gatherings, and imposing mandatory work-from-home measures. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/covid-alberta-reatrictions-1.5832682 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
*****The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[National Health Service]] begins a mass [[vaccination]] campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] using the [[BNT162b2]] [[vaccine]] developed by [[BioNTech]] and [[Pfizer]]. Seniors over the age of 80 and certain [[healthcare worker]]s will be among the first to receive the vaccine. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-55227325 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[Belarus]] exceeds 150,000 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://tass.com/world/1232581 (TASS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Four [[lion|lions]] at the [[Barcelona Zoo]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/four-lions-spanish-zoo-test-positive-covid-19-n1250423 (NBC News)]
*[[2020 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[France]]'s [[Ministry of Agriculture (France)|Ministry of Agriculture]] confirms an outbreak of the highly pathogenic [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|Avian Influenza H5N8]] (bird flu) at a duck farm in [[Bénesse-Maremne]], [[Nouvelle-Aquitaine]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20201208-france-confirms-outbreak-of-highly-pathogenic-h5n8-bird-flu-on-duck-farm (France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**[[Hong Kong Police Force|Police]] in [[Hong Kong]] arrest eight [[pro-democracy]] activists including [[Leung Kwok-hung]] (better known as Long Hair), [[Eddie Chu]], [[Figo Chan]] and [[Wu Chi-wai]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3112960/former-hong-kong-lawmakers-among-least-eight (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**A spokesman for the [[Supreme Court of Iran]] says it upheld a [[death sentence]] against [[dissident]] journalist [[Ruhollah Zam]] "more than one month ago". Zam was found guilty of "[[corruption on earth]]" on charges of spying for [[France]] and [[Israel]] and trying to destabilise [[Iran]] by inciting unrest in [[2017–2018 Iranian protests|2017]] on social media. In court, Zam denied most of the allegations against him and said he was only engaged in "media work". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/8/iran-top-court-upholds-dissident-journalists-death-sentence (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Liberian Senate election]], 2020 Liberian constitutional referendum
**Voters in [[Liberia]] head to the polls for mid-term [[Elections in Liberia|senatorial elections]]. A constitutional referendum is also held, with questions about [[dual citizenship]] and a limitation of term limits for politicians being decided by the electorate. [https://www.liberianobserver.com/news/election-referendum-underway-with-sparse-voter-turnout/ (''Liberian Observer'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/8/liberia-votes-on-george-weahs-plan-to-cut-presidential-terms (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Internal Market Bill]], [[Brexit]]
**[[United Kingdom]] [[Cabinet Office]] minister [[Michael Gove]] announces that the [[UK government]] will withdraw all controversial clauses from the Internal Market Bill. Gove and [[Vice-President of the European Commission]] [[Maroš Šefčovič]] announce "an agreement in principle" on all issues of the [[Brexit withdrawal agreement]], including the [[Brexit and the Irish border#2019 renegotiation: New protocol|protocol on Ireland and Northern Ireland]], border checks, food and medicine supplies and "clarification" on state subsidy rules. [https://www.thenational.scot/news/18929161.brexit-tories-remove-law-breaking-clauses-internal-market-bill-u-turn/ (''The National'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nepal]] and [[China]] agree that the height of [[Earth]]'s highest mountain, [[Mount Everest]], is {{conv|8848.86|m|sp=us}}. [https://www.reuters.com/article/nepal-china-everest/mount-everest-is-higher-than-we-thought-say-nepal-and-china-idUSKBN28I17U (Reuters)] 
*[[Pornography|Pornographic]] website [[Pornhub]], one of the internet's most visited websites, bans users from downloading videos and restricts uploads to certain "partner accounts", following allegations in ''[[The New York Times]]'' that the website hosted [[child abuse]] content. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pornhub-policy/pornhub-bans-video-downloads-following-report-of-alleged-child-abuse-content-idUSKBN28J004 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-55231181 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[2020–21 UEFA Champions League]], [[Racism in association football]]
**[[UEFA]] suspends the [[2020–21 UEFA Champions League group stage|group stage]] match between [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] and [[İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.|İstanbul Başakşehir]] inside the opening 15 minutes, after players from both teams abruptly left the pitch in protest of an alleged racist incident by a match official towards İstanbul Başakşehir assistant manager [[Pierre Webó]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/12/08/football/paris-saint-germain-istanbul-basaksehir-fourth-official-racism-pierre-webo-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
